A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SHQ-NPOV dataset and PE-RL study. Their complete main texts, tables, figures and appendices are readable and matchable despite substantial reorganization and formatting changes.

before.justification: V1 reports original annotation measurements, model evaluations on 1,190 queries, topic-generalization analyses and qualitative generations, including Table 4 and Appendices B and G.

after.justification: V2 retains these original empirical results in Table 2 and the reorganized appendices, and adds reward-model AUC and confidence-interval reporting.

M1.justification: Both versions retain the same LoRA reward and policy adapters, LoRA-SFT initialization, reinforcement-learning procedure and preamble variants. Expanded descriptions and model relabeling do not establish an algorithmic or architectural change.

E1.justification: Both use the same 300-example SHQ-NPOV dataset and 1,190 evaluation queries spanning 89 in-distribution and 30 held-out topics with ten query templates. The topic lists and task requirements are unchanged.

E2.justification: V1 Table 4 and v2 Table 2 retain the same fourteen configurations, including LoRA SFT, full SFT, RLHF and best-of-10 comparisons. PaLM 2 rows are relabeled LLM 20B; the PDFs do not establish a replacement comparator.

E3.justification: The reported training steps, hyperparameters, sample sizes, topic partition, prompting controls and evaluation metrics remain unchanged. Newly disclosed model sizes, compute expenditure and annotator characteristics do not establish changes to the experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The initialization and preamble comparisons, linguistic-feature analysis, topic/template generalization checks and five qualitative examples are retained. Appendix H adds uncertainty reporting for existing comparisons, rather than a new ablation or robustness scenario.

E5.justification: V2 adds Appendix H/Figure 6 with 95% confidence intervals for selected model comparisons. V1 already presented 95% intervals for topic-generalization comparisons. No additional training runs, seed counts or interval-estimation procedure are documented.

E6.justification: All 84 numerical entries in v1 Table 4 and v2 Table 2 are identical. V2 Section 3.3 newly reports 99.3% reward-model AUC. New Figure 6 also introduces inconsistent plotted values: PE-RL + LoRA SFT without a preamble has approximately 88% supportive details, whereas the retained table reports 68.65% in-distribution and 72.67% held-out. This is an unexplained discrepancy, not an established performance gain.

T1.justification: Neither version develops new formal theory or proofs. The scoring definitions and mathematical content are unchanged; moving the extended Wikipedia definition into Appendix A does not introduce new theory.

C1.justification: Both retain the dataset-creation contribution, data-efficient PE-RL findings, headline performance figures and out-of-topic generalization claim. V2 foregrounds PE-RL in the title and abstract without materially changing these claims.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning initialization, negative examples and full-model overfitting remain substantively unchanged. Both retain limitations concerning neutrality definitions, demographic coverage, a single model family and hallucinations. New annotation disclosures describe procedures rather than new applicability boundaries.

D1.justification: V2 adds approximate model sizes, about 50,000 TPU-hours, annotator recruitment/payment/consent information and an Apache 2 dataset license. Its dataset link changes from Google Sheets to GitHub. Conversely, PaLM 2 and Gemini 1.5 identifiers become generic 20B/60B descriptions. Existing training hyperparameters are retained.

R1.justification: V2 adds Beirami et al. (2025) to support best-of-N as an alignment baseline. The broader related-work positioning is retained; the LoRA reference's preprint-to-publication update does not constitute a new cited work.

P1.justification: V2 rewrites the title and abstract, promotes related work to a standalone section, and substantially reorganizes the narrative. The extended neutrality definition, detailed dataset-writing procedure, dataset-characteristics table and query templates move into dedicated appendices, leaving shorter main-text explanations.

P2.justification: The document changes from a single-column ACM manuscript to a two-column layout. V2 restyles the pipeline figure, relocates several tables and figures, stacks previously side-by-side plots, and adds the three-panel confidence-interval Figure 6. Most retained graphical content is unchanged.

improvement.justification: V2 improves annotation, licensing and resource documentation, but removes named model identifiers and introduces an internally inconsistent statistical figure. Figure 6 plots approximately 88% supportive details for PE-RL + LoRA SFT without a preamble despite Table 2 retaining 68.65%/72.67%. These losses in reproducibility and consistency outweigh the documentation gains, while the unchanged main results limit the overall deterioration.
